mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue rising from their current depressed levels, weekday trip chains will expand and retail-and-recreation visits will increase over the next four weeks as commuters add discretionary stops before or after work.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise versus the prior 4-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both increase for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below its recent level, more time spent outside the home translates into immediate discretionary outings, so RETAIL_REC should improve within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL drops below 10 points above baseline after being above that level the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the following week after RESIDENTIAL crosses below 10 or instead declines further.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized rebound in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates looser activity constraints and more on-site circulation, which should lift RETAIL_REC over a two-week horizon.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last 4-week mean after two weeks despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES trending upward.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in PARKS and RETAIL_REC signals warmer-weather leisure substitution toward outdoor activities and nearby shopping, so retail-and-recreation mobility should rise over four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS rises but RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next month, or the two series move in opposite directions for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT keeps falling sharply, the same restriction or deterrence that suppresses commuting also suppresses discretionary shopping trips, producing lower RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 and stays there for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or holds steady over the next two weeks after TRANSIT breaches -45 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM improves while RESIDENTIAL also eases, households are redistributing trips from essential errands toward other destinations, which should pull RETAIL_REC upward within four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises and RESIDENTIAL falls, but RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior four weeks within 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lag rebound in PARKS is an early indicator of general mobility recovery; if outdoor movement broadens, retail-and-recreation visits should follow within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the week after PARKS increases by 10 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: If both WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL stop moving in opposite directions and instead converge toward flatter levels, retail mobility will weaken because the commute-linked shopping channel loses momentum over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next month even though WORKPLACES remains depressed and RESIDENTIAL stays elevated or higher.
